changelog:
- Adds a LIFX skill for operating lights and scenes through an OOMOL-connected account via the `oo` CLI.
- Supports listing visible lights and available scenes for the authenticated LIFX account.
- Provides write actions to activate scenes, set light state, toggle power, and turn off running effects.
- Includes color validation to preview the HSBK values LIFX will apply.
- Documents schema-first action execution and safety guidance for state-changing commands.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@1d96f6f`
summary: LIFX (lifx.com). Use this skill for ANY LIFX request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves LIFX, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
